Use preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42 throughout. For compatible ablations, restore identical initial weights; the same seed alone does not match initialization when architecture changes consume different random draws. Isolate initialization, shuffle, dropout and training-negative RNG streams; match sampler streams across comparable variants so architectural changes cannot silently change negatives. Seed loader workers explicitly ([PyTorch](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/data.html)). These controls support paired comparisons but do not establish robustness across training seeds. Following fixed-hardware benchmarking practice, report validation HR@10 against both optimizer updates/examples processed and elapsed GPU time; epochs alone conceal throughput differences ([AlgoPerf](https://mlcommons.org/benchmarks/algorithms/)). Charge training, diagnostics and failed trials to the shared 43,200 GPU-seconds; sum concurrent trials’ consumption and record software, hardware and timing boundaries.

Keep the pinned users, 99 unique negatives and evaluation seed unchanged. Sampled HR@10 measures this candidate protocol; model ordering need not match full-catalog evaluation ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)). Recommended uncertainty analysis: retain each model’s binary hit per user, bootstrap paired user differences within each category, then average the four category differences equally in each replicate. With 200 users/category, one changed hit moves category HR by 0.5 percentage points and macro HR by 0.125 points. Report category effects and macro confidence intervals, conditional on the fixed candidates and trained models; these omit training-seed and candidate-sampling uncertainty. Four-category averaging does not remove selection bias from repeatedly choosing checkpoints/configurations on the same validation users ([Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)). Predeclare selection and stopping rules, retain every trial’s score and compute cost, label selected validation gains exploratory, and freeze the final predictor before independent held-out evaluation.
